course_name: 製造與工作環境之AR/VR實務
outline:
In this course we introduce how to apply Augmented Reality (AR) and Virtual Reality (VR) technology in manufacturing sectors and work space. This course is aimed to work on practices and exercises for actual applications in industrial cases. The exercised include: AR practices, VR practices, HMI system design, etc.
此課程旨在使學生了解如何把擴增實境(Augmented Reality)及虛擬實境(Virtual Reality)技術應用在製造業以及工作環境之實務設計。實務操作單元包含：人機互動系統實驗。
